v0.1.0.description:
## Install

1. Archipelago **Launcher** → **Install APWorld** → pick `ff8.apworld` (or copy it into `custom_worlds/`), then restart the Launcher.
2. Optional: drop `ff8_ap_tracker.zip` into PopTracker's `packs/` folder.

Requires Archipelago 0.6.7+ and *Final Fantasy VIII* Steam 2013 (`FF8_EN.exe`). Setup guide: the **Final Fantasy VIII** page on your WebHost, or the [Player Guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/commits/v0.1.0

v0.3.0.description:
## Install

1. Archipelago **Launcher** → **Install APWorld** → pick `ff8.apworld` (or copy it into `custom_worlds/`), then restart the Launcher.
2. Optional: drop `ff8_ap_tracker.zip` into PopTracker's `packs/` folder.
3. Optional: `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` is a map preset for the Archipelago Visual Tracker — see below.

### Visual Tracker (new)

`ff8_visual_tracker.zip` pins every FF8 check on clickable world / extras / GF-ability maps inside the [Archipelago Visual Tracker](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) client. To use it:

1. Install [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker) (`tracker.apworld`) and [`visualtracker.apworld`](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) via **Launcher → Install APWorld**, then restart the Launcher.
2. Copy `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` into the `visual_packs/` folder of your Archipelago install (create it next to `custom_worlds/` if missing). Do **not** unzip it.
3. Launcher → **Visual Tracker**, connect to your server/slot; the FF8 preset is picked up automatically.

Visual Tracker support grew out of a community map layout contributed by **caedesender** (Discord) — thank you!

Requires Archipelago 0.6.7+ and *Final Fantasy VIII* Steam 2013 (`FF8_EN.exe`). Setup guide: the **Final Fantasy VIII** page on your WebHost, or the [Player Guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md).


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0
